purpose: P8-B1: rounds 1-15 of the 30 campaigns (5 methods x T0/T1 x seeds 0-2) in the pre-registered ring order; equivalence data/p8-20261022-equivalence-b 6/6 on candidate f662dca6, B1 candidate 3ba20d7e differs only in tools/p8_export.py (analysis) and project_head

output_chain_gate.basis: Recorded engineering acceptance agreement: 4 ms physics step, 12 ms maximum. The 12.5 ms rotor time constant is context, not proof of policy delay tolerance or stability.

methods.offline_rule: lists["<method>/<sut>/<seed>"] of tools/p8/p8_lists.json (60 cases each) taken in order; a case whose gap_spec fit is cancelled would be skipped (does not count), until 30 runs are flown
methods.online_rule: m = p8_methods.Fuzz(sut, seed, p8_space.fits) or BO(...); each round c = m.propose(history); after the run (c, max tilt deg, primary failure) is appended to history. After every propose the history, the proposed case and m.rng.bit_generator.state are written to the campaign state file; a restart restores them and never redraws

rotation.rule: the 30 campaigns in this fixed order (random.Random(20261022).shuffle of the campaign list method-major) form a ring; round k flies the k-th run of every campaign in that order (B1: rounds 1-15, pushed; B2: rounds 16-30)

budget_check.rule: before every run: tools/p8_conditions.budget_check -- p8_space.budget(case) must equal the gap_spec fit of the same case (P6 condition_rule via p6_conditions.fit: pre_gap_s, post_gap_s, or both cancelled) and the windows must be p8_space.windows(case); on any difference the batch stops and writes diagnosis.json (task rule)

mismatches.name: v2.0-H8.0-W0.0-0.78_1.08-1.65_2.31-3.0:T1
mismatches.would_be_flown: no (only positions 1-30 are flown when nothing is skipped)

preflight_check_of_the_offline_lists.cause: both at the exact budget boundary (radius 8.000 m): p8_space evaluates the closed form with a 1e-9 tolerance and accepts; gap_spec uses the runner path check, whose start offset is rounded to 1e-6 m, so the line end exceeds 8.0 m by up to 5e-7 m and the next shrink step is taken
preflight_check_of_the_offline_lists.handling: not changed (task rule): the run that reaches such a case stops the batch with diagnosis.json; the user decides

rules.infrastructure_rule: an infrastructure or evidence failure (any batch check other than the pre-registered flight outcome) is rerun with the same case and a new seed (id suffix -r1, -r2), marked infra_rerun, not counted; at most 2 reruns per run, then the batch stops. Flight failures are results. No run is repeated in place.
rules.cases_log: every run actually flown (incl. infrastructure reruns) appended to <state>/runs/p8_b_cases.jsonl: campaign, k, name, windows, budget check, sim seed, run id
rules.run_ids: <method>-<sut>-s<seed>-k<NN> (infrastructure rerun: suffix -r<N>), directory data/<prefix>-<id>; Gazebo seed = first 31 bits of sha256(prefix/id/master_seed)

criteria.primary: P6 frozen flight-failure criterion (p5.failure_criteria) for p5_gap runs; identification runs use the P6 ident classes

task.rule: fixed second criterion: max tilt >= 45 deg or max altitude loss > 1.0 m (P7 task_failure_criterion window), reported next to the primary one for every run and in every table

flight_failures.safety_envelope: any of tilt >= 45 deg, angular-rate component >= 8 rad/s, horizontal radius >= 10 m, altitude >= 8 m (frozen safety envelope; reaching the limit counts), or a runner safety abort
flight_failures.no_joint_recovery: joint recovery not SETTLED within 10 s after the actual change (frozen P0 thresholds, active controller target)
flight_failures.motor_saturation: any motor at >=0.999 or <=0.001 continuously for at least 0.5 s inside [trigger, window end]
flight_failures.window: [first gap start, end of the post_stream phase] (truncated at an abort); no_joint_recovery is judged from RAPTOR's capture after the final stream stop at rest (frozen P0 thresholds) instead of an owner change

independence.sim_seed: Every P4 batch run gets its own Gazebo seed (gz sim --seed): first 31 bits of sha256(batch prefix + run id + master_seed), recorded in plan.json, config.json and the Gazebo command line. Gazebo sensor noise (IMU, barometer, magnetometer) is drawn from this seed; without --seed it is drawn from std::random_device.

initial_yaw.rule: P6 draws no random heading: every run spawns at yaw 0 (PX4 heading 96.0 deg).
initial_yaw.heading_rule: Gazebo yaw is counter-clockwise from East (ENU); PX4 heading is clockwise from North (NED) incl. the world magnetic declination. At spawn yaw 0 the PX4 heading is 96.0 deg (P3 batch-01 first C->N 95.99-96.05 deg; P4 dev-01 95.9 deg), so the expected heading before arming is 96.0 - initial_yaw_deg (tolerance 3 deg).

independence.hover_point: Not perturbed: the local frame origin is the spawn point and the Gazebo world is flat and translation invariant, so a horizontal offset of the hover point changes nothing the controllers or the physics see; the hover altitude stays the frozen 3 m (analysis references).
independence.verification: Before the batches: (1) startup-only runs with seeds A, A, B compare the at-rest raw gyro noise (sensor_gyro) sample by sample: same seed identical, different seed different; (2) development flights with different seeds/headings give different measured values; (3) every batch run checks that its Gazebo command carried the planned seed and that the heading at takeoff equals the planned heading (tolerance 3 deg).
independence.default_settings: Every P8 batch run (incl. equivalence and development) gets its own Gazebo seed.
